<includeonly><span class="pdx-hover" style="border-bottom:1px dotted; cursor:help;" title="{{{2|}}}">{{{1|}}}</span></includeonly><noinclude>
== Purpose ==
Shows the first parameter, with the second as a tooltip. '''pdxparse''' uses it
where the game shows a short phrase whose full condition is too long for the
table cell, e.g. <code><nowiki>{{hover|Has had the focus|<long trigger text>}}</nowiki></code>.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{hover|visible text|tooltip text}}
</pre>

== Accessibility note ==
A <code>title</code> tooltip is invisible to touch devices and to most screen
readers. Where the hidden text is essential rather than supplementary, prefer
putting it in the cell directly. pdxparse only uses this template for
supplementary detail.
